views.markdown: Lyrics in the Lock Screen date view! (iOS 16.0+)
**Semi-jailbreak note:** Inject into the stock Music app if using native Apple Music lyrics, or enable Musixmatch in settings to fetch lyrics independently.

### Version 4.0.9
- Added word-by-word lyrics from QQ Music and NetEase
- Shared lyric fetching and offline storage with CoreLyrics and LyricBridge
- More reliable lyric loading and word-by-word upgrades

### Version 4.0.7
- Tidier lyric storage and more complete cleanup
- Settings and preview improvements
- Fixed clearing logs leaving old entries behind

### Version 4.0.6
- Added Megalobiz lyric support
- Online and external app lyrics enabled by default
- Short, Long and No Limit request timeouts
- Strict and Relaxed song matching
- Faster fallback when Musixmatch can't load
- Added a Wipe Lyrics Cache button with cache size shown in settings

### Version 4.0.5
- Loading indicator stays visible while fetching lyrics
- Clearer lyric service descriptions and loading notes

### Version 4.0.4
- Added LRCLIB, NetEase and QQ Music lyric services
- Customizable lyric service priority
- Improved song matching, ad-lib filtering and general reliability

### Version 4.0.3
- Fixed AOD lyrics stopping after locking; extra line refresh is now enabled by default
- Timed-out paused lyrics stay hidden through AOD and lock/wake changes
- Live settings preview refreshes Musixmatch lyrics and supports real one-line scores
- Developer diagnostics are hidden and switched off on every install/update

### Version 4.0
- Redesigned settings with a live, song-synced lyric preview and font previews
- Native Always-On Display lyrics with smooth progressive fill and marquee lock/wake handoffs
- Smoother play/pause motion, backward seeking and interrupted transitions
- Improved ad-lib highlighting and long/split lyric lines
- Experimental Spotify, YouTube, Pandora and other app support through Musixmatch (opt-in)
- Improved offline caching and faster recovery when skipping songs quickly
- Lyric animations and timers suspend when the Lock Screen/Notification Center is hidden or the display is fully off

### Version 3.0
- Musixmatch lyric API fetching added
- Added marquee scrolling
- Additional performance and caching improvements
- Coming next: Spotify and broader media-app support

### Version 2.3
- Reworked lyric engine = lower CPU usage
- Line transitions animate in reverse when scrubbing backwards

### Version 2.2
- Fixed opacity highlighting when ad-libs were hidden

### Version 2.1
- New **Opacity** syllable highlighting style
- Toggle to split long syllable-supported lyrics
- Ad-libs can now be toggled on/off
- LSDateView appearance now reverted upon pause

### Version 2.0
- Added line-by-line transition animations
- Custom lyric fonts now supported
- Ad-libs now handled properly (?)
- Option to keep previous syllables highlighted
- Live lyric preview added to preference pane
